import numpy as np
import bisect
import statistics
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data, value):
    data_list = list(data)

    if len(data_list) == 0:
        return np.array([]), 0

    sorted_data = sorted(data_list)
    avg_value = statistics.mean(sorted_data)

    greater_than_avg = np.array([x for x in data_list if x > avg_value])
    count_greater_than_value = len(sorted_data) - bisect.bisect_right(sorted_data, value)

    plt.figure()
    plt.hist(sorted_data, bins='auto', edgecolor='black')
    plt.title("Histogram of Sorted Numbers")
    plt.xlabel("Value")
    plt.ylabel("Frequency")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    plt.close()

    return greater_than_avg, count_greater_than_value
